constraints: Edit only the design sections named in the objective; do not restructure the rest of the document.
Every number you introduce must also appear in the formula or table it belongs to, or be marked TBD.
Use only names, places and terms defined in the glossary and world docs; propose new ones under remaining_risks instead of inventing them silently.
New proper nouns must be added to the glossary in the same round, with a one-line definition.
Data files are the source of truth for numbers; do not hard-code the same values in game code.
State the formula or curve behind each changed value in remaining_risks if it is not already documented.
Every new resource needs at least one source (faucet) and one sink in the data you write or already present.
Save only the files listed in the asset manifest, at exactly those paths.
Follow the art bible for palette, outline and camera angle; use the reference images it names.
